rappel_detail.anchor: two-piton station equalized with cord (or a slung horn)
rappel_detail.station: The summit area. The short aid block just below the top has one newer bolt and one old quarter-inch bolt with an aging hanger; do not trust the old bolt alone.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 3, on two ropes, down the south face to the Pernod-Chablis notch. A single 70 m just barely works; a single 60 m leaves you several metres short.
hazards: Rope-eating cracks sit a few feet below the slung-horn station: build that anchor as high as practical so the rope does not jam on the pull.

rappel_detail.anchor: anchor at the top of the Chablis East Face rappel line
rappel_detail.station: From the notch, a short 4th-class scramble regains the East Face rappel line on Chablis.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 3, double-rope, down Chablis’s East Face line.

rappel_detail.anchor: next station on the Chablis East Face line
rappel_detail.station: The next station down the Chablis line.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 3 of 3, double-rope, to the base.

set.rappels: 3 double-rope rappels (two 60 m ropes): one down Pernod’s south face to the Pernod-Chablis notch, then two down the Chablis East Face line to the base
